name: codex-design-studio
description: DSH-style design workbench inside Codex: device-framed previews, click-to-edit annotations and live tweaks.

interface.shortDescription: Open HTML design workbench in the plugin sidebar.
interface.longDescription: Shows Open Design HTML artifacts in device frames inside the Codex sidebar. Click any element to create an annotation with its CSS selector and source location; adjust design tokens with live sliders and write them back to the HTML file.
defaultPrompt: Show me the current design workbench
